" By means of magic arts, an invisible foe bas slain thoae two,

Rama and his brother are lying struck down on the battlefield, 
there is no burden too heavy for death to shoulder ! Fate is 
inexorable. I do not weep so much for Rama and Lakshmana 
or for myself or my mother but for my unfortunate mother-in-

brief.summary_1line: Ravana shows Sita the apparently slain Rama and Lakshmana; Sita laments fate and false prophecies until Trijata reassures her they still live.

image_candidates.scene_text: From the airborne Pushpaka chariot, Sita looks down in horror at Rama and Lakshmana lying motionless on the battlefield, surrounded by grieving monkeys.
Sita collapses in the chariot weeping, her hands raised in lament while the rakshasis stand around and the city of Lanka glitters below.
Trijata gently gestures toward the calm monkey army guarding the fallen brothers as she reassures the distraught Sita that they still live.
